veranderings.rede: 'hoort aan' means 'belongs to (an owner)'; 'sit' is the natural verb for a position and matches the block heading.
'ratels ... (kokonratels) ratel' repeats the same stem three times in one sentence; 'rammel' keeps the meaning and leaves the protected compound untouched.

vlae.teks: 'n Instrument met houtlatte wat jy met kloppers slaan.
vlae.rede: 'kloppers' for mallets is uncommon in Afrikaans (a 'klopper' is usually a door knocker or beater); a writer may prefer 'stokkies', but the choice touches what the learner pictures, so it is flagged rather than changed.
